# Bashref 2.1.0

Bashref 2.1.0 is a reference-depth and project-maturity release.

## Installation

```bash
pipx install https://github.com/MMKarii/bash-fa-reference/releases/download/v2.1.0/bashref-2.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
bashref --version
bashref doctor
```

## Highlights

- 214-record Persian/English structured Bash reference corpus
- broad `set -o` shell-option coverage
- broad `shopt` coverage
- major Bash variable coverage
- individual compound-command syntax records
- `bashref stats`
- `bashref doctor`
- INSTALL, HACKING, AUTHORS, and NEWS project documents
- immutable v2.0 and v2.1 documentation snapshots built from release tags
- version-aware public release verification

## Artifacts

The release includes wheel, source distribution, DEB, RPM, portable archive, man-page archive, completion archive, documentation archive, Homebrew formula, and `SHA256SUMS`.

## Checksums

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```
